get.description: Uptime probe: 200 when the database answers, 503 otherwise. Public on purpose; it reveals nothing else.

delete.description: Deletes every stored document the person owns: the files first, then the records.

get.description: The person downloads their own data as one JSON file.
Totals of users, workspaces, plans and AI usage, plus the accounts that cost most. 403 unless a platform admin.
Built-in rules (changelog) and runtime versions with validity, source and status. 403 unless a platform admin.

post.description: Proposes a new version (status `proposed`). It changes nothing in the engine until another admin approves it.
Attaches a reference case (inputs and expected outputs) to a rule id. Cases are evaluated at approval.

get.description: One runtime version with payload, reference cases and the latest evaluation.

post.description: Approves a proposed version. 403 for the proposer; 422 (with the case results) when a reference case fails.

get.description:
Workspace metadata of one person (names, plan, counters; never content). 403 unless an admin AND the person
has an active support consent. Each call is an audit row the person can see.

put.description: Suspends or reactivates an account. 403 unless a platform admin. Audited; the person sees the row.

get.description: Needs a signed-in user (like every other route); the list itself is static.

schema.title: Response Agent Templates V1 Agent Templates Get

get.description: The latest decision for each purpose.

put.description:
Revoking `documents` stops new uploads at once (the upload checks the latest decision); existing files stay.

`analytics` (funnel events without values or messages) is opt-in and can be switched off at any time.

get.description: Enqueues the recurring jobs, then runs what is due. Called by the external scheduler (Vercel Cron sends the secret).

post.description: SPED EFD (#173): same preview-then-confirm flow and the same idempotency key (access key) as the NF-e batch.

delete.description: Deletes the file first, then the record, so a failure never leaves a stored file the person thinks is gone.

get.description:
A fresh, short-lived signed URL. Visibility is decided by the caller's own session (RLS).

`inline=true` drops the attachment name so the browser's viewer shows PDF and images (#165).

post.description: IPTU, IPVA or ITR for the year as informed by the user; no rate is estimated, so no amount asks for it.
Capital gain tax of a simulated sale, with premises; without the acquisition cost it asks for it.
Upcoming federal obligations of the regime, with the business-day rule and what is not covered.
What the company pays in the competence month, by tax, with the rules used and the calculation memory.
Monthly tax computed with the rules in force each month; only months with recorded data, never an estimate.
ITCMD on an inheritance or donation by UF; a UF without a checked table asks for validation.
Legal savings found for the company, each with its premises; nothing is shown without them.
Annual IRPF of a person in the simplified and the complete model, and which one is better.
Self-employed vs MEI vs Simples for a service provider: taxes of the month in each, with the premises.
The company's yearly load today against each year of the IBS/CBS transition. Reference rates are informed.

get.description: Every version of every rule with its source and validation state, and the rules that ended or are about to.

parameters.description: Month used to look for rules about to expire
parameters.name: today

schema.title: Today

post.description: Today against a scenario: `overrides` are the company fields that change.
The home-screen question: finds the first space of the kind it is about, creates one when there is none.

get.description: Who the API thinks the caller is. Also the cheapest way for the front-end to check its token.
Per-day totals of the last `days` days. `costUsd` is an estimate from list prices, not an invoice.

delete.description: Ends every active consent right now.

get.description: The caller's consents for support to see their workspace metadata, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Support Access V1 Me Support Access Get

post.description: Lets the support team read workspace metadata (names, plan, counters; never content) for `days` days (max 7).

get.description: Client workspaces, the ones needing most attention first (unread notices + missing documents, then name).

schema.title: Response Portal Clients V1 Portal Clients Get

post.description: Thumbs up/down (with an optional reason) on one AI answer; one rating per message per user.

get.description: Public, no login. The token is hashed here; the database compares hashes, so no secret is ever matched in clear.

post.description: Receives one Web Vital from a real visit and logs it (CLS is sent times 1000). Public and tiny: no user data accepted.
First visit: a company space and a personal one, unless the person already has spaces. Idempotent.

get.description: Members read (RLS). Only agents that built a panel appear; the main dashboard is not listed here.
Newest first, at most 50; `?unread=true` keeps only the ones not read yet.

post.description: Marks every unread notice of the workspace as read (RLS lets only the owner).
Marks one notice as read; 404 when it is not in this workspace or the caller is not the owner (RLS).

patch.description: Pauses (`active: false`) or resumes an alert. Resuming re-arms it, so a limit already crossed notifies again.
Marks a comment as resolved (or reopens it). RLS lets only whoever may comment, and only these two columns.

delete.description: "Apagar conversa": removes the saved conversation and leaves a trace in the audit trail.

post.description: Moves/resizes a block as a new dashboard version, so the manual edit can be undone like a chat one.

get.description: `period` is YYYY-MM (default: this month). Done = a document of the type arrived in the month (the year, if annual).
The report's tables (diagnosis, opportunities, ...) as a spreadsheet that opens with pt-BR separators.
Issued reports, newest first. Anyone who can see the workspace reads the list (RLS).
A fresh signed URL of the stored PDF: it opens exactly as it was issued.

post.description: Generates the PDF on the server and keeps it in the workspace's history (private bucket). Only the owner issues.

get.description: The newest review of each subject, each with `valid`: false when the data or the rules changed since.
